data.description:
## Description

Implement the `review.verifier_enabled` feature flag, `review.verifier_failure_threshold` config, cascading-failure brake, and telemetry emission across `verifier.py`, `runner.py`, and config docs.

## Done Definitions

- `verifier.py` reads `review.verifier_enabled` (default `false`) via `read-config.sh`; when `false`, `dispatch_verifier()` returns findings unchanged without calling the verifier agent
- `verifier.py` reads `review.verifier_failure_threshold` (default `0.30`); validates range `(0.0, 1.0]`; raises `ValueError` on out-of-range values
- Cascading-failure brake: when `failure_rate > verifier_failure_threshold` AND `in_scope_finding_count >= 5`, `dispatch_verifier()` returns a `VERIFIER_BRAKE_ACTIVE: true` signal in output metadata; runner.py logs warning and holds autonomous-resolution loop attempt counter for affected findings
- Telemetry fields added to verifier dispatch output and surfaced in `merged` findings JSON:
  - `verifier_confirm_count`, `verifier_downgrade_count`, `verifier_drop_count`, `verifier_failure_rate`, `verifier_minor_finding_rate`, `verifier_fingerprints[]`
- `dso_ci_review/verifier.py` wraps entire dispatch in `try/except`; any exception annotates all in-scope findings with `verifier_status: failed`, flag=true still returns findings (never blocks record-review.sh)
- `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` updated with new config keys: `review.verifier_enabled`, `review.verifier_failure_threshold`, `review.verifier_strict_after`
- Review-stats aggregation (`scripts/review-stats.sh` or equivalent) surfaces new telemetry fields
- Running `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_feature_flag.py` exits 0 after this task

## File Impact

- `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/verifier.py` — UPDATED
- `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py` — UPDATED (flag check, telemetry propagation)
- `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` — UPDATED (3 new config keys)
- `plugins/dso/scripts/review-stats.sh` (or equivalent aggregator) — UPDATED (telemetry fields)

## Testing Mode

GREEN — makes T1 tests pass
